name: actions/split-action-button
title: Split action button
description: One main action with alternatives behind a seam.

keyboard.action: On the main half, run the main action; on the menu button, open the menu.
On the menu button, open the menu on the first item. In the menu, move down (wraps).
On the menu button, open the menu on the last item. In the menu, move up (wraps).
Move to the first or last item.
Close the menu and return focus to the menu button.
Close the menu and move on.
Jump to the next item starting with that letter.

notes: Two native buttons. The narrow one follows the WAI-ARIA menu button pattern: `aria-haspopup="menu"`, `aria-expanded` and `aria-controls`.
The menu is a `menu` of `menuitem`s labelled by its button. Focus moves onto the items, and disabled items stay focusable so they can be discovered.
Choosing an item, or pressing Escape, returns focus to the menu button.
The menu closes on a click outside it and when focus leaves it.
accessibility.reducedMotion: The menu appears without its short drop, and the chevron flips without turning.
